name: The Reunion
source:
After the breakup between you and your girlfriend you receive a phone call from your old buddy from grade school. He wants to meet up at the local bar and you're thrill to meet him again. However, an unexpected turn of event occurs when you're introduced into someone new... yet very old.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/orborigin]Patreon[/url]]
